items.title: Stratifying lung adenocarcinoma: a novel prognostic model based on mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization activity.
items.excerpt: Mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) is a core apoptotic regulatory event that dictates mitochondrial integrity, where full activation drives cell death and sublethal dysregulation contributes to tumor genomic instability. items.title: Agomelatine as augmentation therapy with second-generation antipsychotics for negative symptoms of schizophrenia: An open-label randomised clinical trial and electroencephalogram-derived model for treatment response prediction.
items.excerpt: Negative symptoms are a core diagnostic domain of schizophrenia that affect functional outcomes and remain difficult to treat.
